title: Devops Engineer
description:
Context

We are a fast-growing startup that has experienced tremendous growth over the past months, achieving 8x revenue growth in the last 18 months and a 10x usage increase over the same period. As we continue this upward trajectory, we are expanding our team to ensure our products remain reliable, intuitive, and delightful for our ever-growing user base.


Mission

As a DevOps/Infrastructure team member, your primary mission will be to help ensuring that our infrastructure is scalable, reliable, and cost-effective, supporting the company’s rapid growth and evolving needs. You will play a critical role in both day-to-day operations and long-term strategic planning, helping shape our platform's future.


Key Responsibilities:
  • Infrastructure Scaling and Stability : Contribute to the continuous scaling of our infrastructure to handle increasing loads while maintaining stability and performance. This includes designing and implementing robust and scalable architectures, automating deployment processes, and optimizing resource allocation.
  • Performance Optimization : You will continuously monitor and analyze system performance, identifying bottlenecks and areas for improvement. You will also work on optimizing our infrastructure and applications to ensure low-latency, high-throughput operation, particularly for video and audio processing.
  • Cost Management : Implement strategies to optimize infrastructure costs without compromising performance. This includes rightsizing resources, automating scaling policies, and leveraging cloud provider cost-saving mechanisms.
  • Enhancing Observability : Improve our monitoring and observability capabilities, ensuring we have comprehensive visibility into the health and performance of our infrastructure. You will develop and maintain dashboards, alerts, and logs that provide actionable insights for the entire engineering team.
  • Collaboration and Support : Work closely with developers and other stakeholders to ensure seamless integration between infrastructure and applications. Provide guidance and support on infrastructure-related topics, fostering a culture of shared responsibility for the system’s reliability.
  • Security and Compliance : Contribute to the security and compliance of our infrastructure by implementing best practices and staying up-to-date with industry standards.
  • Innovation and Continuous Improvement : Stay abreast of industry trends and technologies and proactively suggest and implement improvements. You will have the opportunity to experiment with new tools and methodologies, driving innovation within the team.
Who We Are Looking For

We seek a highly skilled and experienced DevOps/Infrastructure Engineer who is passionate about building and maintaining scalable, reliable, and efficient infrastructure. You should have a strong background in managing complex environments across cloud providers and bare-metal servers and be comfortable working in high-performance environments, proactively identifying and resolving potential issues before they impact the system.


Key Qualifications:
  • Kubernetes Mastery : Proven experience designing, deploying, and managing Kubernetes clusters in production environments.
  • Multi-Cloud and Bare Metal Expertise : Deep understanding of at least one primary cloud provider (AWS, GCP, or Azure) and experience managing infrastructure on bare-metal servers. You should be familiar with each environment’s unique challenges and opportunities and capable of leveraging their strengths effectively.
  • Infrastructure at Scale: Demonstrated ability to architect and manage infrastructure that can scale horizontally and vertically, supporting a growing user base and increasing traffic. Experience with distributed systems, load balancing, and automated scaling strategies is essential.
  • Cost Optimization & Resource Management : Strong focus on optimizing infrastructure to balance performance and cost. You should be proficient in tools and techniques for monitoring resource usage, identifying inefficiencies, and implementing cost-saving measures.
  • Programming and Automation : Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.G.Bash, Python).
  • Monitoring and Observability : You should have a deep understanding of best practices for monitoring, logging, and observability. Experience with tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, ELK stack, or similar systems is crucial. You should also be able to design systems that provide comprehensive insights into infrastructure health and performance.
  • Problem-Solving Mindset : You should thrive on solving complex problems and constantly look for ways to improve system reliability, performance, and efficiency. Strong analytical skills and a methodical approach to troubleshooting are essential.
  • Collaboration and Communication : Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders. You should be comfortable collaborating across teams to ensure that infrastructure decisions support broader company goals.


Bonus Qualifications:
  • Experience with Media Processing : Familiarity with video and audio processing, streaming, or related technologies is a strong advantage. This includes understanding the performance implications and resource requirements of media workloads.
  • Familiarity with the Node.Js environment and applications at scale is a strong advantage
  • Familiarity with configuration management tools like Ansible, Terraform, or Puppet is a plus

A Aegea é a empresa líder no setor privado de saneamento básico no Brasil. Trabalhamos por um futuro sustentável, colocando nossa paixão na prática fazendo a diferença nos +800 municípios em que atuamos. Empenhamos todos os esforços para contribuir com a sociedade por meio de inovações e serviços que vão além do tratamento e da distribuição de água e esgotamento sanitário. Nossa paixão é tornar cada dia melhor tanto o ambiente que oferecemos aos nossos colaboradores, bem como nos serviços que entregamos. Somos uma marca que pede licença para melhorar a vida da população de centenas de cidades, levando bem estar e prosperidade.


Nossos talentos são o que a Aegea Saneamento e suas concessionárias tem de único. Somos formados por mais de 21.000 colaboradores espalhados por diversos cantos do Brasil, levando soluções de saneamento eficiente e sob medida, respeitando as peculiaridades dos locais onde estamos presentes. Trabalhamos diariamente na construção de uma empresa eficiente, diversa, ética e sólida, buscando aprender e evoluir constantemente.

title: Engenheiro De Software Sênior
description:
Somos mais que um supermercado!


A startup que já economizou mais de R$ 30 milhões a milhares de brasileiros e dobra de tamanho a cada 3 meses, desde sua fundação (em 2015). Em 2021 conseguimos levantar cerca de R$300 milhões em duas rodadas de investimento com gente fora da curva, como José Galló (ex-CEO da Renner), GIC, Ariel Lambrecht (fundador da 99 e da Yellow), Minerva Foods, entre outros. Acreditamos que um país melhor é feito de empresas mais eficientes e de pessoas que trocam velhos hábitos por escolhas mais inteligentes. E trabalhamos por isso. Por essa visão de país melhor, aplicada ao setor que atinge a todos os brasileiros: o setor de produtos essenciais de consumo, mais conhecido como "setor supermercadista". Mas esqueça esse nome: "supermercado". Somos mais que isso. Somos um sistema de reabastecimento. E queremos ser o maior e melhor sistema de reabastecimento do Brasil. Esse é nosso sonho. "Um mundo onde os produtos essenciais cheguem na sua casa com a mesma facilidade que a água chega na torneira".


Quer participar desse sonho com a gente?


Sobre o Papel


Estamos procurando um(a) pessoa Desenvolvedor Full Stack Web - Sênior para desenvolver soluções de alto desempenho. Neste papel, você deve ter habilidades de comunicação e possuir capacidade de priorizar o seu próprio trabalho. Você garantirá que nossas aplicações e sistemas funcionem corretamente e tenham um bom desempenho. A posição é aplicável para trabalhar de maneira remota para os candidatos que residem fora na cidade de São Paulo. Para os candidatos que estão na cidade de São Paulo, a posição seria híbrida, para ir 3x na semana presencial.


Responsabilidades


  • Desenvolver e implementar funcionalidades alinhadas aos requisitos e objetivos definidos pelas áreas de negócio;
  • Identificar, diagnosticar e corrigir bugs reportados pelas áreas de negócio, assegurando a estabilidade e a confiabilidade do sistema;
  • Analisar os requisitos de negócio em conjunto com as áreas responsáveis, identificando necessidades e oportunidades de melhoria no sistema;
  • Colaborar na elaboração do planejamento técnico para a implementação dos requisitos, incluindo a definição de arquitetura, ferramentas e abordagens de desenvolvimento adequadas;
  • Monitorar continuamente o desempenho e a disponibilidade da aplicação, identificando proativamente eventuais falhas, gargalos ou inconsistências para garantir seu pleno funcionamento e minimizar interrupções;
  • Elaborar e manter a documentação detalhada de todas as soluções implementadas, incluindo descrições técnicas, mudanças realizadas e justificativas, para facilitar a manutenção, futuras atualizações e a consulta por outras equipes;
  • Participação emreuniões de planejamento e revisão utilizando metodologia Scrum.


Qualificações

  • Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência com desenvolvimento;
  • Conhecimentos em ReactJS, NodeJS e Python;
  • Conhecimento básico de arquitetura de software;
  • Familiaridade com Git e GitHub;
  • Experiência em trabalhar com metodologia Scrum;
  • Desejável: Conhecimento em serviços da AWS.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
This is a dynamic role that involves navigating through various responsibilities within the Finance department. The ideal candidate should be able to cover for employees during vacation periods and maternity leave, and eventually, by mid-next year, assume a Finance Analyst role responsible for Sales Invoices and Accounts Payable.

We are looking for someone willing to lead and execute a project to automate our accounts payable process by implementing CNAB file usage (the system already supports this functionality). During this transition period, the candidate will gain experience across different areas of the Finance organization, which will strengthen their knowledge and prepare them to take on the main responsibilities.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Receive daily picking lists from Logistics, insert selected serial numbers into the system, verify item balances and weight distribution, and input transportation and other outbound data.
  • Register invoices with the government, issue them to customers, and send product quality certificates.
  • Create various invoice types: consignments, alternate delivery addresses, industrialization, branch transfers, and exports.
  • Weekly, handle fiscal appointments related to issued invoices, including customer communication and issuing correction letters or other adjustments.
  • Compare weekly DDA-bank data with system records to ensure all open items are posted and approved.
  • Generate and send one weekly payment file to the bank, process the return file, and reconcile posted amounts.
  • Twice a month, organize intercompany international payments, perform cash flow analysis, gather documentation, send to the bank, and register payments.
  • Support month-end closing by reconciling accounts such as stock, intercompany payables, and imports in transit.


Required:

  • Bachelor degree in Business Administration, Accountant or other related areas.
  • Advanced English.
  • Excel skills.
  • Knowledge of accounts payable, invoicing, or accounting processes.


Desirable:

  • Experience working with SAP B1.
  • Speak Spanish (intermediate level).
  • Experience working with CNAB files.

title: Aprendiz
description:
PHINIA : Avançando a sustentabilidade hoje, alimentando sem carbono amanhã.

Na PHINIA, criamos sistemas de combustível premium, sistemas elétricos e peças de reposição para veículos com motores de combustão interna (ICE) e aplicações industriais. Garantimos que nossos produtos sejam limpos, eficientes e de alto valor, porque sabemos que as ações que tomamos hoje terão um impacto profundo no mundo de amanhã. Nosso objetivo? A tecnologia ICE mais limpa: combustão livre de carbono.

Sempre a PHINIA coloca a qualidade em primeiro lugar, continuando nosso legado com mais de um século de rica experiência e inovação tecnológica. O nome PHINIA tem raízes relacionadas a “brilhante” e “futuro”, representando nossa confiança e compromisso em melhorar o mundo.


Nossa cultura

Acreditamos que a saúde e a segurança de nossos funcionários são uma prioridade, nos preocupamos com nossas comunidades locais e com o meio ambiente global. A PHINIA promove e nutre um ambiente diverso e inclusivo, honra a integridade, busca a excelência, se compromete com a responsabilidade por nossas comunidades e pelo meio ambiente e se baseia no poder da colaboração.


Oportunidades de carreira

Estamos recrutando aprendizes, com vínculo com a instituição de ensino CIEE.

Nossa empresa oferece ensino prático em diversas áreas, tanto na produção quanto administração. O CIEE juntamente com a empresa tem programas de treinamento e desenvolvimento para que os aprendizes adquiram habilidades e conhecimentos que serão úteis ao longo de suas carreiras. Além disso, os jovens terão a oportunidade de trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares, com profissionais experientes, o que permitirá um aprendizado completo e enriquecedor. Buscamos jovens engajados, proativos e que possuam interesse em aprender e crescer profissionalmente.

Não deixe essa chance passar, pois pode ser o seu primeiro passo para um futuro promissor. Faça parte do time PHINIA e saia na frente no mercado de trabalho!


Principais responsabilidades

Atuar em áreas administrativas, logísticas ou produtivas, auxiliando nas atividades especificas de cada departamento.


Requisitos necessários:

Ter de 16 a 20 anos;

Disponibilidade para trabalhar de manhã e/ou a tarde;

Curso de informática será um diferencial;

Não é necessário ter experiência profissional;

NÃO estar cursando ensino superior.

Desejável: cursos técnicos.


Valores PHINIA

Liderança de produto - Inovação que agrega valor aos nossos clientes

Humildade - Buscar diversas perspectivas e trabalhar de forma colaborativa

Inclusão - Reconhecer nossas diferenças nos torna mais fortes;
somos ousados e intencionaisN

et-Zero - Comprometida com a eficiência energética, redução de resíduos e reutilização benéficaI

ntegridade - Assumir a responsabilidade por nossas decisões e fazer o que é certoR

esponsabilidade - Assumir a propriedade de nossas ações e gerar resultados.


Segurança

Esta posição aderirá ao Programa de Segurança Global Star, incluindo regras de segurança, práticas e treinamento conforme descrito no Manual de Política de Segurança PHINIA, que inclui o uso de equipamentos, dispositivos de proteção ou roupas que o empregador exige. Esse indivíduo trabalhará de maneira a enfatizar a importância da prevenção de acidentes e doenças. Deve tomar todas as precauções razoáveis na circunstância dada para a proteção de si e dos colegas de trabalho. Além disso, é responsável por relatar todas as lesões e/ou possíveis situações perigosas, incidentes ou ocorrências ao superior imediato.


Oportunidades iguais de emprego

PHINIA é uma empresa com oportunidades iguais de emprego, de modo que todos os candidatos qualificados serão considerados para novas oportunidades, independentemente de raça, cor, idade, religião, sexo, orientação sexual, identidade/expressão de gênero, nacionalidade ou deficiência.


Nenhuma indicação não autorizada de recrutadores e fornecedores

PHINIA não aceita currículos não solicitados ou ofertas de recrutadores terceirizados ou agências de recrutamento associadas a quaisquer oportunidades de emprego publicadas ou não publicadas. Quaisquer informações não solicitadas enviadas à PHINIA serão consideradas desimpedidas e isentas de qualquer taxa ou encargo. Somente membros de nossa Equipe de Recursos Humanos têm autoridade para contratar ou autorizar serviços de recrutamento, os quais devem ser acordados antes do recebimento do currículo ou oferta não solicitada.

title: Aws Devops Engineer (Temporary)
description:
Job Description

About you

You are someone who wants to influence your own development. You’re looking for a company where you have the opportunity to pursue your interests and be able to grow professionally.


You bring to Applaudo the following competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent work experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in a DevOps or related role.
  • Proficiency in AWS cloud services, specifically IAM, RDS, and EKS.
  • Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) tools, such as Terraform.
  • Strong background in setting up and managing CI/CD pipelines.
  • Familiarity with monitoring tools, especially Datadog.
  • Knowledge of SOC2 compliance standards and security best practices.
  • Experience with VPN configuration, Cloud IdP (such as JumpCloud), and network security.
  • Certifications in AWS (e.G., AWS Certified DevOps Engineer) or security (e.G., CISSP) are desirable.
  • Experience with additional cloud providers (e.G., Azure, GCP) is a plus.
  • Proficiency in scripting and automation tools (e.G., Python, Bash) is desirable.
  • Familiarity with microservices architecture and container orchestration.
  • Advanced english proficiency.


You will be accountable for the following responsibilities:

  • Infrastructure Management: Manage both employee and organizational infrastructure to ensure seamless operations.
  • VPN Configuration & Management: Configure and manage VPN access to secure connections for employees.
  • Cloud Identity Provider (IdP) Management: Oversee JumpCloud or equivalent cloud IDP services for secure user management.
  • Employee Onboarding & Offboarding: Manage workstation setups, configurations, and removals during employee transitions.
  • Infrastructure as Code (IaC): Implement, manage, and maintain infrastructure as code using Terraform for streamlined infrastructure deployment.
  • AWS Account & IAM Management: Oversee AWS IAM roles, permissions, and account setups for both employees and applications.
  • Database Cluster Management: Scale and manage database clusters and connectivity using AWS RDS, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Microservices Infrastructure: Maintain and optimize microservices infrastructure on AWS EKS (Elastic Kubernetes Service).
  • Monitoring & Alerting: Design and implement robust monitoring and alerting systems with Datadog to ensure proactive issue detection and resolution.
  • Continuous Integration/Continuous Deployment (CI/CD): Develop and maintain CI/CD pipelines to support efficient, reliable, and secure deployment processes.
  • SOC2 Compliance: Ensure all company data systems meet SOC2 standards and regularly review for compliance adherence.
  • Information and Network Security: Establish, enforce, and enhance network security measures, following industry best practices.
  • Penetration Testing & Audits: Conduct recurring penetration tests and audits as per company policies, addressing vulnerabilities promptly.

  • Celebrations

title: Pessoa Analista De Desenvolvimento De Sistemas Sênior
description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história

Entre para a história de construção do maior Hub de Dados e Analytics do Brasil.

Além de você contribuir diretamente neste objetivo, você estará se desenvolvendo constantemente, por meio de grandes desafios de negócio, junto a um time de alto impacto. Na Neoway, acreditamos em fazer as coisas de forma inovadora, colaborativa, responsável e com foco no cliente.


#Missão do cargo :

Como Pessoa Desenvolvedora de Software com foco em Design System, sua missão será projetar, construir e evoluir os fundamentos da interface dos produtos da Neoway. Você será responsável por transformar conceitos de design em componentes de código reutilizáveis, eficientes e agnósticos. Seu trabalho impactará diretamente a produtividade de dezenas de outros desenvolvedores e a consistência da experiência de todos os nossos usuários. Buscamos um perfil colaborativo, que queira construir junto, evoluir a arquitetura atual e compartilhar conhecimento.


#Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Trabalhar na concepção de soluções técnicas, na quebra de tarefas, planejamento e na execução das demandas;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, participando e fomentando práticas de Code Review e desenvolvimento orientado a testes;
  • Manter, monitorar e garantir a eficiência dos serviços construídos e de responsabilidade do seu time;
  • Colaborar nas definições de arquitetura e escalabilidade dos nossos produtos.
  • Criar soluções com base em uma arquitetura distribuída e de microserviços
  • Trabalhar com modelo de dados hierárquico e de grafos
  • Criar soluções resilientes e que estejam dentro dos padrões altos de performance
  • Observar o desenvolvimento seguro e estar sempre por dentro de atualizações de segurança e critérios relevantes relacionados ao desenvolvimento seguro
  • Arquitetar e desenvolver componentes de UI utilizando tecnologias como Lit (Lit-html / LitElement), garantindo que sejam performáticos, acessíveis e framework-agnostic.
  • Colaborar intensamente com designers para traduzir protótipos e diretrizes visuais em componentes técnicos bem estruturados.
  • Definir e documentar as melhores práticas, APIs e padrões de uso para os componentes do Design System.
  • Atuar como um ponto de referência e suporte para os times de produto, ajudando-os a consumir o DS e a resolver desafios de implementação.
  • Manter a qualidade e a saúde do código da biblioteca através de testes automatizados, code reviews e processos de CI/CD.
  • Pesquisar e propor evoluções na arquitetura de front-end, pensando sempre na escalabilidade e manutenibilidade a longo prazo.
  • Participar ativamente das cerimônias do time, contribuindo com sua visão técnica para o planejamento e execução das demandas.

#Requisitos e qualificações:

  • Visão de produto e arquitetural: Ser capaz de pensar nos componentes como um produto interno, considerando seu ciclo de vida, versionamento e o impacto de suas decisões a longo prazo.
  • Sólida experiência com JavaScript/TypeScript e os fundamentos da web (HTML5 semântico e CSS3).
  • Experiência prática na construção ou manutenção de um Design System ou biblioteca de componentes.
  • Experiência com Web Components, especialmente utilizando bibliotecas como Lit (LitElement/Lit-html).
  • Conhecimentos avançados em acessibilidade (WAI-ARIA) e telas responsiva, tratando-os como requisitos fundamentais e não opcionais.
  • Domínio de arquitetura CSS, incluindo pré-processadores (STYLUS/SASS) e metodologias (BEM ou similares).
  • Experiência com ferramentas de documentação e catalogação de componentes (ex: Storybook).
  • Conhecimentos em UX;
  • Experiência nastécnicas de Cross-Browser Development;
  • Ter atuado com diferentes frameworks de SPA (React, Vue, Angular), compreendendo os desafios de criar componentes agnósticos e interoperáveis.
  • Experiência na construção de aplicações integradas a APIs (REST).
  • Ter algum conhecimento de back-end ou ter atuado como Full Stack.
  • Conhecimento em execução de sistemas baseados em containers (Docker).


#NeoJourney l Cardápio de Benefícios:

Vale Alimentação/Refeição;

title: Technical Service Engineer - Building Materials (Mortar Powder & Coatings)
description:
About the Role:

We are seeking a skilled Technical Service Engineer to provide expert technical support and solutions for our Mortar Powder & building material coatings product lines. This role combines hands-on field troubleshooting, customer training, and collaboration with R&D to optimize product performance and ensure customer satisfaction in construction, industrial, and architectural markets.


Responsibilities:

  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting
  • Serve as the primary technical contact for customers, distributors, and sales teams, resolving issues related to product application, performance, and compatibility (e.G., adhesion failure, curing defects, durability concerns).
  • Conduct on-site visits to diagnose problems and recommend solutions for Mortar Powder (e.G., concrete additives, mortar mixes) and coatings (e.G., epoxy, waterproofing, decorative finishes).
  • Product Training & Documentation
  • Develop and deliver technical training programs for customers, contractors, and internal teams on product usage, safety protocols, and best practices.
  • Create detailed technical documentation, including application guides, safety data sheets (SDS), and troubleshooting manuals.
  • Product Optimization & Testing
  • Collaborate with R&D and QA teams to improve product formulations based on field feedback and performance data.
  • Perform lab and field tests to validate product compatibility with substrates (concrete, wood, metal) and environmental conditions (humidity, temperature).
  • Compliance & Sustainability
  • Ensure products meet industry standards (e.G., ISO, ASTM) and environmental regulations (e.G., low VOC, REACH compliance).
  • Advocate for sustainable solutions, such as eco-friendly coatings or recycled sand powder applications.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Support sales teams by participating in client meetings, demonstrating product value, and addressing technical inquiries during pre- and post-sales phases.
  • Work with supply chain to address logistics or raw material challenges impacting product performance.


Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Chemistry, or related field. Advanced degrees or certifications (e.G., NACE, SSPC) are a plus. 3+ years of experience in technical service, R&D, or application engineering within the building materials, coatings, or construction chemicals industry. Sherwin williams,Sika,etc are preferred.


Required Skills:

  • In-depth knowledge of Mortar Powder applications (e.G., cementitious systems) and coating technologies (e.G., epoxy, polyurethane, acrylic).
  • Proficiency in laboratory testing methods, data analysis, and root-cause analysis for product failures.
  • Familiarity with CAD software, simulation tools, or digital tools for technical documentation is advantageous.


Preferred Skills:

  • Experience with green building certifications (e.G., LEED, BREEAM).
  • Multilingual skills for roles supporting global markets (e.G., Spanish, Portuguese, Mandarin).
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% for customer site visits and industry events.

title: Senior Accountant
description:
About Us

We are a fast-growing restaurant group based in the United States, focused on delivering high-quality dining experiences and operating with strong financial discipline. Our locations serve thousands of guests every week, and we are committed to excellence in both customer experience and operational performance.

The company has expanded steadily over the past several years, and we are preparing for continued growth. With multiple concepts and locations under management, we need a Senior Accountant who can help build the financial systems, processes, and reporting that will support us as we scale.


Role Overview

We are seeking a Senior Accountant to oversee accounting and financial operations across our restaurant group. This role is responsible for ensuring accurate financial reporting, implementing strong controls, and supporting decision-making with timely analysis. You’ll work closely with the leadership team to manage budgets, streamline processes, and provide insights that improve profitability.

This is a hands-on position where you’ll both manage the numbers day-to-day and help design the systems that will carry the company forward.


What You’ll Do

  • Oversee all accounting operations, including A/P, A/R, payroll, and general ledger
  • Prepare monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements
  • Manage cash flow, budgets, and forecasts to support company growth
  • Ensure compliance with tax filings, audits, and regulatory requirements
  • Implement and improve accounting systems, policies, and procedures
  • Partner with operations leadership to track restaurant performance and profitability
  • Provide detailed financial analysis and reporting to guide business decisions


What We’re Looking For

  • Careful attention to detail and accuracy in financial work
  • Strong organizational skills and ability to prioritize in a fast-paced environment
  • A proactive mindset—able to spot issues early and propose solutions
  • Clear communicator, both written and spoken
  • Strong knowledge of accounting systems (QuickBooks, NetSuite, or similar)
  • Proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets for financial modeling and reporting
  • Collaborative approach to working with operations and leadership teams


Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field
  • Valid registration with the CRC (Conselho Regional de Contabilidade) in Brazil (Contador habilitado)
  • At least 5–7 years of professional experience in accounting/finance, ideally including restaurant, hospitality, or retail sector experience
  • Strong knowledge of full-cycle accounting, financial reporting, and internal controls
  • Experience with U.S. GAAP or IFRS reporting standards
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel and Google Sheets for financial modeling and reporting
  • Strong English communication skills (written and spoken)


Preferred

  • U.S. CPA license or progress toward CPA certification
  • Experience working with U.S.-based companies, subsidiaries, or international operations


Software Experience

  • Microsoft Office: must have
  • Quickbooks Online: Strong preference
  • Toast: Nice to have


Growth Potential

This role offers the opportunity to help shape the financial foundation of a growing restaurant group. As the company expands, the Senior Accountant will play a key role in building out the finance function.

description:

Estamos na vanguarda da resolução de problemas de negócios, proporcionando impacto real em escala global.


Ao se juntar à Stefanini, você se torna parte de uma jornada global de transformação. Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui!


Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança!


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Administração de redes Wi-Fi : configuração e suporte em controladoras Cisco (WLC 25XX, 35XX, 55XX, 98XX);
criação e manutenção deSSIDs com autenticação MAC, 802.1X, Portal Guest (ISE), e APs em modo Local/Flexconnect.

Segurança da informação : sustentação de firewalls Palo Alto, Cisco ASA (FTD-Standalone) e Firepower + FMC;
criação e revisão de regras, URL Filtering, Application Control, gestão de VPNs (Client-to-Site – Global Protect) e ambientes em HA.

Infraestrutura LAN : configuração de switches Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX), VLANs, interfaces trunk/acesso e políticas de port-security.

Conectividade WAN : operação e monitoração de ambientes SD-WAN (Aruba SilverPeak), aplicando conceitos de alta disponibilidade e otimização de tráfego.

Monitoramento proativo : administração da ferramenta SolarWinds (nodes, alertas, tuning de monitoramento).

Relacionamento com vendors : abertura e gestão de chamados junto a TAC Cisco e Palo Alto, acompanhamento de incidentes críticos e processos de RMA.

Documentação e melhoria contínua : elaboração de procedimentos técnicos, relatórios de incidentes e recomendações de boas práticas.



Requisitos e qualificações

Formação superior completa em Engenharia de Computação, Redes, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas ;

Experiência prática em suporte e sustentação de redes corporativas de grande porte ;

Domínio em Cisco Wireless (WLC) e Switching Cisco (29XX, 92XX, 95XX) ;

Experiência sólida em Firewall Palo Alto e Cisco Firepower/ASA ;

Conhecimento em VPNs, URL Filtering, HA e Application Policies ;

Vivência com ferramentas de monitoramento SolarWinds ;

Imprescindível Inglês avançado.


Atuação Remota em escala 12x36 das 18 às 06h.


Informações adicionais

O que te oferecemos:


Vale Alimentação ou Vale Refeição;

Desconto em cursos, universidades e instituições de idiomas;

Academia Stefanini - plataforma com cursos online, gratuitos, atualizados e com certificado;

Mentoring;

Auxílio Creche;

Clube de vantagens para consultas e exames;

Assistência Médica;

title: Strategic Partnership & Alliance
description:
About RateGain

RateGain Travel Technologies Limited is a global provider of AI-powered SaaS solutions for travel and hospitality that works with 3,200+ customers and 700+ partners in 100+ countries helping them accelerate revenue generation through acquisition, retention, and wallet share expansion. RateGain today is one of the world’s largest processors of electronic transactions, price points, and travel intent data helping revenue management, distribution and marketing teams across hotels, airlines, meta-search companies, package providers, car rentals, travel management companies, cruises and ferries drive better outcomes for their business.

Founded in 2004 and headquartered in India, today RateGain works with 26 of the Top 30 Hotel Chains, 25 of the Top 30 Online Travel Agents, 4 of the Top 5 Airlines, and all the top car rentals, including 16 Global Fortune 500 companies in unlocking new revenue every day.


Exploring the role

RateGain is privileged to partner with hotels of every size and type around the world to achieve their commercial objectives – from independent, luxury, lifestyle, and boutique hotels, to the world’s largest chains. Chains - and multi-site operators - have unique business requirements, additional complexity, and often use more diverse technology solutions. As a partner of choice for global and regional chains, RateGain is looking to further serve this important segment of the hospitality industry and seeks an experienced Director focused on European markets, to further scale this essential unit of our business.

The ideal candidate will understand how Latam hotel chains function and operate, and will be familiar with the technology solutions adopted by these chains to achieve their commercial objectives. The role requires a trusted advisor, able to assist chains to manage through the complexities of the travel technology eco system to guide them to the right decisions in the areas of distribution, business intelligence, marketing technologies, and beyond.

This is an individual contributor role and, as such, the candidate is expected to be a self-started and self-driven, ready to innovate to find new values for our hotel chain clients whilst keeping the company goals and the bigger picture firmly in mind. This position can be based anywhere in Latam and needs to have the ability to travel within the Latam without limitations.


How your day will look like/Job responsibility

  • Build and manage strategic alliances with regional and local partners (e.G. RMS, PMS, booking engines, OTAs)
  • Define and execute a partnership roadmap aligned with RateGain’s GTM strategy in LATAM
  • Identify co-marketing, co-selling, and integration opportunities with key players in the hospitality and travel ecosystem
  • Collaborate with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Product, Legal) to structure and execute partnership agreements
  • Represent RateGain in industry events and partnership meetings to promote our brand and solutions
  • Monitor partner performance, engagement, and contribution to pipeline and revenue
  • Provide regular reporting and insights on partnership outcomes and market trends


Education & Work Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field
  • 5+ years of experience in business development or strategic partnerships


Knowledge:

  • In-depth understanding of the LATAM hospitality and travel technology ecosystem
  • Knowledge of SaaS business models and partnership structures
  • Awareness of regional trends, customer behavior, and competitive landscape in the travel and hospitality sectors


Skills:

  • Strong negotiation and deal-closing capabilities
  • Excellent relationship management skills with ability to engage partners at all levels
  • Advanced verbal and written communication skills in Spanish, Portuguese, and English
  • Ability to identify, pitch, and convert strategic partnership opportunities
  • Proficiency in using CRM and sales enablement tools
  • Skilled in cross-functional collaboration with internal teams (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Product, etc.)


Attitude:

  • Proactive and results-oriented, with a strong drive to exceed targets
  • Entrepreneurial mindset with a passion for growth and innovation
  • Culturally sensitive and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in a global, remote team
  • High level of integrity, professionalism, and ownership
  • Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced and evolving environment

Equal Opportunity Employer

We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer and are committed to providing a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome and encourage applications from all qualified individuals, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, genetic information, disability, or veteran status.

title: Netsuite Accountant
description:
Staff Accountant (Remote) – USA Clients

Location: Remote – Brazil

Salary: USD 1,700/month

Schedule: 40 hours/week


About Us

We are a dynamic and growing U.S.-based accounting firm specializing in providing financial services across a wide range of industries. Our team is composed of highly skilled professionals who are passionate about delivering exceptional results and building long-term client relationships. TGG Accounting is growing, and we’re looking for a Staff Accountant with NetSuite experience and strong process enhancement and implementation skills to join our remote team. If you're detail-oriented and passionate about financial reporting, budgeting, and variance analysis, this is your chance to work with top-tier US clients.


MIT — Most Important Thing

The Staff Accountant is responsible for following the TGG Way standards for processing and implementing the day-to-day transactional accounting to produce complete and accurate financial statements. The Staff Accountant is required to build and maintain positive relationships with clients, clients’ staff, co-workers, and managers. Understanding source documents, inputting them, and filing them correctly is a key part of the Staff Accountant’s job. Using critical thinking and having a proficiency in intermediate accounting, the Staff Accountant is responsible for the accurate data entry of all transactions into the accounting system.


Responsibilities

  • Accounts Payable & Receivable: Processing invoices, applying payments, and reconciling transactions accurately and efficiently.
  • Bank & Credit Card Reconciliations: Performing soft reconciliations weekly and hard reconciliations monthly, ensuring accuracy in coding and matching transactions. Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and intercompany accounts in NetSuite .
  • Month-End Workbooks: Preparing and reconciling schedules for various accounts such as AR, AP, payroll accruals, loans, and fixed assets. Execute timely and accurate month-end close processes under tight deadlines.
  • Financial Reporting: Mapping accounts, syncing data, and generating financial reports using TGG templates. Analyze and review month-over-month income statements, making necessary adjustments (e.G., prepaid expenses, accrued expenses, fixed assets, and managing cash flow).
  • NetSuite: Utilize NetSuite for bank feeds, reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable processing, generating reports, and posting journal entries. This includes running balance sheets and profit & loss reports, entering invoices and bills, and creating customers and vendors.
  • Communication and Task Management: Using Asana to update and manage tasks and Bizinta for time entries with detailed descriptions.



Requirements

  • 2–3 years of accounting or finance experience doing month-end close processes, bank reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
  • Education: Accounting or Finance degree preferred.
  • Technical Knowledge: Strong proficiency in NetSuite (or similar ERP) and Excel.
  • Strong background in process enhancement, process implementation, and system optimization.
  • Communication: Fluent in English, both written and spoken, with excellent attention to detail and analytical skills.
  • Strong understanding of debits/credits, journal entries, and accrual-based accounting.
  • US GAAP knowledge required;
    IFRS familiarity is a plus.
  • Experience working with European entities is a plus.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating with a remote team.
  • Working Equipment to start is required.
  • Working hours based on client


Perks & Benefits

  • Unlimited PTO Policy, including all Holidays.
  • 1 Month of Paid training in advanced accounting, U.S. GAAP, and NetSuite.
  • Full access to TGG University and learning materials.
  • Career development through mentoring, training, and long-term growth opportunities.


About TGG Accounting

At TGG Accounting, our mission is to make business owners’ lives better through excellent financial management. We provide outsourced accounting and advisory services to small and mid-size businesses, helping them build strong financial foundations, plan for growth, and make better decisions.

We are more than 250 teammates, located across the U.S. and around the world in the Philippines, Argentina, Ecuador, Chile, Brazil, Peru, and Mexico, working together in a vibrant, multicultural environment to deliver on our mission.

Our Core Values

  • Loyalty
  • Integrity
  • Strong Work Ethic
  • Forward Thinking – Growth Mindset
  • Team Player / Caring / Selfless
  • Positive Energy – People who have fun, smile, and laugh
  • Freedom & Accountability

title: Phd Peer Reviewer Needed: Professor Of Clinical Medicine
description:
We are currently looking for researchers, retired researchers, and former researchers who can perform peer reviews for journals and publishers.

Note: This is a high-paying part-time job that allows for remote work . Please read the recruitment requirements carefully and fill out the application form accurately. Thank you.

WHAT YOU NEED to Have

  • Doctorate PhD or equivalent advanced degree in the subject area
  • Published at least 3 paper in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past two years
  • Published at least 12 papers in SCIE/SSCI/A&HCI journals in the past ten years
  • Thorough understanding of research methodologies and ethical principles within the relevant discipline
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills
  • Strong written communication skills , with the ability to provide clear, concise, and constructive feedback
  • Ability to adhere to deadlines and manage time effectively
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and objectivity
  • Prior experience as a peer reviewer for academic journals is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with online manuscript submission and review systems

WHAT YOU WILL DO

  • Assess Novelty : Evaluate whether the manuscript is original and adds new knowledge or insights to the field of study.
  • Evaluate Study Design and Methodology : Check whether the study design and methods are appropriate, comprehensive, and clearly described to ensure reproducibility.
  • Literature Review : Ensure the manuscript thoroughly incorporates and cites relevant, up-to-date research in the field.
  • Analyse Results and Conclusions : Determine whether results are presented clearly and appropriately, and whether conclusions are supported by the data and significant to the field.
  • Provide Constructive Feedback : Suggest improvements and highlight any flaws, omissions, or ethical concerns.
  • Recommend Publication : Based on your evaluation, the journal editor will decide whether the manuscript should be accepted, revised, or rejected.

O Analista de Prevenção a Riscos e Fraudes Pleno será responsável por investigar denúncias e suspeitas de fraudes no Grupo Petrópolis, recebidas pelo Canal de Conduta e outros meios oficiais. O profissional atuará de maneira imparcial, ética e legal, visando identificar e esclarecer fatos, fraudes de colaboradores e terceiros. Manter-se atualizado quanto às normas e procedimentos internos relativos às investigações e prevenção a fraudes.

Auxiliar na criação de materiais e apresentações para reporte à gestão, além de apoiar na elaboração e revisão de diretrizes e procedimentos do departamento.



DIFERENCIAIS:

  • Experiência em Segurança Pública: Profissionais com histórico em segurança pública, como policiais, bombeiros ou agentes de segurança;

title: Coordenador(A) De Torre De Controle De Operações (Control Tower)
description:
O Coordenador de Torre de Controle de Operações será responsável por garantir a governança e o atingimento dos indicadores-chave de performance (KPIs) de toda a cadeia operacional da Privalia. Essa posição atuará de forma transversal, conectando áreas como operações comerciais (planejamento de campanhas de flash sales ), S&OP, armazém, transportes, qualidade, gestão de estoques, logística reversa e demais times dentro da estrutura de operações.

O papel envolve ser os “olhos” da gestão em toda a operação, assegurando que os KPIs corretos estão sendo medidos em tempo real, antecipando riscos de ruptura, conduzindo rituais de alinhamento diário entre áreas e estruturando planos de ação que suportem a entrega de metas de custo, prazo e qualidade.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:


Governança e Monitoramento de KPIs:

  • Garantir que todos os indicadores de performance operacional estejam claramente definidos, medidos em tempo real e acompanhados com disciplina;
  • Produzir dashboards e relatórios de acompanhamento diário, semanal e mensal.

Gestão Interdepartamental

  • Conduzir reuniões de alinhamento entre áreas (revisões diárias, semanais, mensais), assegurando clareza sobre status, tendências e planos de ação;
  • Atuar como ponto focal da performance operacional, cobrando entregas e facilitando a resolução de problemas.

Antecipação de Rupturas e Planos de Ação

  • Identificar desvios e riscos operacionais antes que impactem os resultados;
  • Estruturar e acompanhar planos de correção com os responsáveis de cada área.

Inteligência de Dados e Análise Preditiva

  • Liderar a frente de inteligência de dados de operações, garantindo qualidade, integridade e disponibilidade das informações;
  • Desenvolver análises preditivas e uso de inteligência artificial para melhorar visibilidade, previsibilidade e eficiência operacional.

Qualidade Operacional

  • Acompanhar aderência aos processos, investigar causas de falhas e estruturar melhorias.
  • Apoiar auditorias internas, revisões executivas e iniciativas de padronização de processos.



Requisitos e qualificações:


  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Economia, Matemática, Logística ou áreas correlatas;
    pós-graduação/MBA será considerado diferencial.
  • Experiência prévia em funções de control tower, gestão de operações, supply chain ou qualidade operacional .
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com domínio de ferramentas de BI (Power BI, SQL, Python, etc.) e conhecimento em estatística ou análise preditiva.
  • Experiência em condução de rituais de governança, acompanhamento de KPIs e gestão de planos de ação.
  • Boa comunicação e habilidade de relacionamento interdepartamental, com perfil de cobrança estruturada e colaborativa.

O que oferecemos?


Além de um clima descontraído, sem política de dress code e total open space , compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:

title: Engineering Manager
description:
Salary = ~30k BRL


Company Description

Cubbo is a tech-driven platform that helps business grow. We empower retailers, ecommerce, fintech, banking, direct selling, and multi-level marketing (MLM) companies to deliver faster while reducing costs and increasing customer loyalty. Our platform integrates a crm, warehousing, inventory management, fulfillment, and last-mile logistics into one seamless experience. By managing all carriers and providing advanced tools, Cubbo helps brands scale profitably. Our mission is to give every company in Latin America the power to offer world-class fulfillment, creating long-term growth through speed, reliability, and customer-first logistics.


Role Description

This is a full-time on-site role for an Engineering Manager located in São Paulo, Brazil. Our office is based in Pinheiros. The Engineering Manager will be responsible for overseeing engineering projects, managing software development processes, and leading a team of engineers. Day-to-day tasks include project management, integrating various systems, and ensuring seamless collaboration among team members. The role also involves setting goals, monitoring progress, and facilitating technical discussions to drive innovation and efficiency.


Outcomes (What success looks like in year one)

  1. Team Growth & Leadership – Build, mentor, and retain a team of high-performing engineers in São Paulo. Achieve an employee engagement score of 8/10+.
  2. Delivery Excellence – Ensure the team consistently delivers product increments on time with high quality, hitting 90%+ of sprint commitments.
  3. System Reliability – Improve uptime and reduce critical incidents (target: <
    1% downtime, <
    2 major incidents per quarter).
  4. Scalable Architecture – Partner with product and leadership to define and deliver a roadmap that scales our platform for 10x volume growth.
  5. Engineering Processes – Implement effective agile practices, code review standards, and CI/CD pipelines to reduce cycle time by 30%.
  6. Cross-Team Collaboration – Establish strong collaboration with product, design, and operations teams in Mexico and Brazil, with positive feedback from stakeholders.


Competencies

  • Technical Leadership – Strong software engineering background, ideally in logistics, SaaS, or high-scale platforms.
  • People Leadership – Proven experience managing and growing engineering teams, fostering career growth, and building culture.
  • Execution Focused – Bias for shipping and iterating quickly while maintaining quality.
  • System Thinker – Able to design and guide implementation of scalable, reliable systems.
  • Clear Communicator – Fluent in English and Portuguese;
    able to align local teams with global leadership.
  • Founder Mindset – Resourceful, entrepreneurial, comfortable working in fast-moving startup environments.


Responsibilities

  • Lead the use of AI-coding tools.
  • Lead and manage the engineering team in São Paulo (hiring, mentoring, performance reviews, team culture).
  • Drive execution of the product roadmap in collaboration with product and design teams.
  • Establish and maintain high engineering standards: code quality, testing, security, and scalability.
  • Own team ceremonies (standups, sprint planning, retros) and foster a strong agile culture.
  • Act as the technical point of contact for leadership, providing visibility on progress, risks, and opportunities.
  • Partner with product leadership to balance speed vs. quality trade-offs.
  • Build a strong engineering culture that attracts top talent in Brazil.

Se você tem experiência com .NET C# , domínio em SQL Server e gosta de mergulhar na análise e resolução de problemas técnicos, essa oportunidade pode ser para você.


O que você fará no dia a dia?

  • Atuar no atendimento de chamados técnicos de nível 2 , em parceria com a equipe de suporte.
  • Analisar, debugar e corrigir problemas em sistemas desenvolvidos em .NET 8 / C# .
  • Executar correções de bugs e desenvolver pequenas melhorias nas aplicações existentes.
  • Apoiar na criação e manutenção de scripts SQL , incluindo queries complexas, views e procedures.
  • Contribuir com scripts de implantação e rotinas para onboarding de novos clientes .

O que esperamos de você?

  • Experiência prática com .NET C# , preferencialmente com versões mais recentes (.NET 6+ ou 8).
  • Conhecimento sólido em SQL Server , incluindo leitura e escrita de queries, troubleshooting e otimização.
  • Familiaridade com resolução de problemas em produção e sustentação de sistemas.
  • Boa comunicação para interação com o time e clareza na documentação de soluções.
  • Perfil analítico, colaborativo, com proatividade e foco em entrega.


O que oferecemos?

  • Ambiente colaborativo com espaço para troca de conhecimento e crescimento técnico.
  • Oportunidade de trabalhar em sistemas robustos e desafiadores, com alto impacto nos clientes.
  • Participação em melhorias contínuas e evolução da nossa plataforma SaaS.
  • Flexibilidade e integração com um time experiente e comprometido.

title: Class Coordinator - Higher Education Institution
description:
Join OPIT - Open Institute of Technology , an EU-accredited Higher Education Institution revolutionizing computer science education. We offer modern, competence-based, online BSc and MSc degrees in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Cybersecurity, and Digital Business all taught in English.


We're seeking for a Class/Program Coordinator to support our online BSc and MSc programs. Work closely with academic staff, faculty members, and students to ensure program quality .


Your Role:

  • Provide administrative support to academic staff and faculty, manage course schedules, and maintain records and databases.
  • Act as the primary contact for students, handling administrative requests, technical issues, and inquiries.
  • Monitor student enrollment and progress, offering guidance as needed.
  • Facilitate communication between academic staff and students, ensuring prompt responses to queries.
  • Plan and coordinate events, seminars, and workshops to support student learning and engagement.
  • Liaise with tutors to ensure timely assessment and feedback delivery.
  • Maintain records, reports, and program-related documentation.


Ideal Candidate:

  • Proficiency in English (C1+), other languages are a plus.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Education, Business Administration, or a related field.
  • 1-2 years in a similar role, preferably in higher education.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills, managing multiple tasks effectively.
  • Familiarity with online learning management systems and educational technologies.
  • Demonstrated commitment to excellence in teaching and a passion for computer science education.


✨ What's in it for You:

  • Exciting and dynamic and international work environment


What next?

  • We will assess your application and if you have what we’re looking for, you'll be contacted for a preliminary interview
  • If we like what we hear, we will invite you to participate in a second-round interview with the Director
  • If you make it to the shortlist, you'll be invited to meet the Team!



The job is full-time

Candidates must possess a valid Brazilian tax identification number (CPF for individuals or CNPJ for companies) to be considered for this role.

title: Business Director
description:
Why Join Us?

  • Competitive salary
  • Private health insurance and paid vacation benefits
  • Senior leadership role with high visibility and direct impact across Latin America
  • Opportunity to represent an established global iGaming company at events, exhibitions, and partner meetings


Who Will You Work For?

A leading international iGaming provider with a strong presence across multiple regions, now expanding its commercial leadership in Latin America. The company is committed to innovation, strategic growth, and building long-term partnerships in the online gaming space.

With a portfolio that includes top-performing slot game products, the company is trusted by partners worldwide for delivering engaging, high-quality solutions. As part of its LatAm expansion, we’re seeking a Business Director / Manager in Brazil to drive strategic partnerships, lead the team, and grow the company’s influence in the region.


Why This Role?

As the Business Director / Manager, you’ll be the driving force behind expanding and strengthening B2B partnerships across Brazil and Latin America. You will lead negotiations, shape go-to-market strategies, and ensure seamless execution of commercial projects.

This role is ideal for a commercially driven leader with an established network in the iGaming industry, strong knowledge of the Brazilian and LatAm markets, and the ambition to grow business relationships in a highly competitive space.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Expand and negotiate B2B iGaming partnerships across Brazil and Latin America
  • Identify potential partners and adjust strategies based on market changes and opportunities
  • Plan and execute integrated online and offline marketing campaigns
  • Analyze market trends, competitors, and player behaviors to provide actionable insights
  • Promote slot game products effectively to partners, designing tailored solutions when needed
  • Coordinate with internal teams to ensure smooth project execution and delivery
  • Stay current with Latin American market dynamics and gaming regulations
  • Represent the company at industry exhibitions and events to build brand influence
  • Lead and motivate a regional team to enhance efficiency and performance


Requirements:

  • Must be based in Brazil (Brazilian nationality preferred)
  • Fluent in English and Portuguese (Spanish is a plus)
  • Established network/resources in the B2B iGaming industry within Latin America
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience at a large B2B iGaming company in the region
  • Proven experience in partnership expansion, commercial negotiations, and market strategy
  • Strong communication, coordination, and cross-cultural skills
  • Willingness to travel occasionally across the region
  • Leadership and management experience is an advantage


Benefits:

  • High-impact, senior-level role with ownership of LatAm growth strategy
  • Exposure to international markets and opportunities to represent the brand globally
  • Collaborative and ambitious company culture focused on long-term growth


Ready to take on a leadership role in shaping the future of iGaming partnerships across Latin America? Apply now and be part of a company driving innovation and growth in the region.

title: Gerente De Loja
description:
VEM DAR UM INICIAR A SUA CARREIRA NA MAIOR EMPRESA DE ARTIGOS ESPORTIVOS DA AMÉRICA LATINA!

DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Que tal entrar para o nosso #TimedeCampeões ?

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória, é apaixonado por esporte, acredita no trabalho em equipe e está disposto a correr junto com os nossos clientes.

Aqui é lugar de gente que tem sede de vitória!

Se você tem vontade de aprender e crescer com um time que joga entrosado, essa oportunidade é para você!

RESPONSABILIDADES E ATRIBUIÇÕES


Para entrar em campo nesta posição, você precisa:

  • Acompanhamento de vendas/metas diárias e o resultado operacional da loja, através de análises e propondo melhorias para resultados;
  • Estimular e fortalecer junto a liderança de loja, a entrega de KPI de resultados, por meio de feedbacks e alinhamentos;
  • Ser elemento propagador dos conceitos de qualidade e atendimento, mantendo alto nível de relacionamento com a equipe, a fim de otimizar os processos e as vendas;
  • Realizar as entrevistas de pessoas e inserir planejamento no desenvolvimento de carreira, observando e fortalecendo as competências individuais;
  • Promover a diversidade entre pessoas de forma a construir uma loja com equidade.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÕES ✅


Pra jogar bonito você precisa ter:

  • Ensino superior completo;
  • Experiência anterior com gestão de pessoas;
  • Experiência anterior com gestão de resultados;
  • Conhecimento nosegmento de varejo;
  • Conhecimento emInformática e no no Pacote Office;


SOBRE A CENTAURO

A Centauro é a maior empresa de artigos esportivos da América Latina. Nossa maior missão é mobilizar pessoas e transformar vidas por meio do esporte, por isso, nos orgulhamos da nossa trajetória, que iniciou em 1981 e resultou em nossas mais de 220 lojas, presentes em todas as regiões do Brasil.

Por aqui, cada jogada é ensaiada e nossos craques contam com técnicos, líderes de lojas e todas as ferramentas necessárias para uma visão estratégica de jogo!

O clima em loja é de descontração, mas quando chega a hora da partida, cada craque veste a camisa da sua posição e joga junto dos clientes. E se você precisar de ajuda, saiba que nosso time #jogaentrosado , afinal, aqui #miramosotopo.

Muito mais que uma loja, a Centauro é um lugar de histórias escritas por vencedores. Vem fazer seu nome, vem fazer parte do nosso #TimeDeCampeões!

title: Project Engineer
description:
Project Engineer – Substations & High Voltage


(ENGLISH SPEAKERS)


Location: The Netherlands (on-site), 1-2 - year contract with potential of permanent employment, NOT project/freelance


Are you passionate about large-scale infrastructure and high-voltage energy systems? Join a forward-thinking engineering team dedicated to delivering cutting-edge solutions in substations (up to 500kV) and energy transmission projects across global markets.


We're looking for an experienced Project Engineer to support the design, development, and delivery of substation and high-voltage projects. You’ll collaborate with a multidisciplinary team, contribute to energy transition solutions, and bring excellence to our electromechanical and protection systems.


Key Responsibilities:


  • Develop basic and executive electromechanical designs for high-voltage substations (69kV to 500kV)
  • Prepare and analyze layout drawings, grounding mesh, cable routing, and auxiliary systems (AC/DC)
  • Design single-line, three-line, and interconnection diagrams
  • Ensure compliance with international standards (IEC, ANSI, IEEE, ABNT)
  • Perform technical documentation review and approval (FATs, BOMs, technical specs)
  • Interface with clients, suppliers, and cross-functional engineering teams
  • Contribute to engineering reports including ROI, CAPEX, and technical feasibility


What We’re Looking For:


  • Degree in Electrical Engineering or related field
  • Minimum 4+ years of experience in high-voltage substation design (preferred: 230kV to 500kV)
  • Proficiency with AutoCAD (See Electrical, Eplan P8 or similar is a plus)
  • Familiarity with SCADA, protection and control systems
  • Solid knowledge of substation equipment: CTs, PTs, surge arresters, circuit breakers, transformers, disconnectors
  • Experience with software like CYMCAP, DiaLUX, PVsyst (nice to have)
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work in multicultural environments
  • English proficiency required;
    Portuguese or Spanish is a plus


Bonus:

  • Experience with renewable projects (photovoltaic farms, hybrid systems)
  • Exposure to EPC projects and multidisciplinary coordination
  • Understanding of ESG practices in engineering


Why Join Us:

  • Work with industry leaders in power and energy systems
  • Get involved in international projects with real impact
  • Grow within a dynamic and mission-driven company
  • Remote flexibility and a collaborative, innovation-driven culture



Who is Xelvin?


Xelvin is a Dutch consultancy company specializing in Engineering and Technical Trades. We hire Artisans, National Degree, Bachelor, Masters and PHD candidates with a background in Mechatronics, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Automotive and Physics. Our focus is within the High-Tech and Manufacturing industry in Eindhoven region.


Xelvin is specialized in International Recruitment, within Europe and beyond. In the past years we have helped over a thousand candidates from more than 50 different nationalities with finding their perfect job here in the Netherlands and are striving to help so many more!


As Xelvin we hire candidates for a specific position for a set amount of time, after which a permanent contract with our client is granted and the candidates automatically transfers.


What do we offer?


Contract wise:


· 1-2 year contract of 40 hours per week (with potential of long-term employment).

· 25 paid holidays a year (+ potential ADV days)

· Public holidays, with a maximum of 7 per year, which are paid by Xelvin.

· Holiday allowance of 8.33% (instead of 8,0%) over your total gross annual income. Paid each year in May.

· Overtime and shift allowance will be paid by Xelvin accordingly.

· Travel allowance of €0,23 per km, for the use of travelling to work and back home.

· Competitive salary (based on level of education and experience)



Onboarding & benefits:


· Your 1st house in the Netherlands will be supported by Xelvin, with the help of our Housing Consultant (we help you find accommodation). In case of having to pay the 1st months rent or potential deposit, Xelvin is willing to pay it for you upfront, after which we’ll set up a loan agreement, for you to pay us back in terms.


· A relocation assistance allowance of €1000 - €3000,00 NET will be paid to you, to assist with the cost of relocating to the Netherlands.


· You (and your family/partner) will be picked up at the airport or train station by your consultant/ recruiter after your arrival and will be taken to your new house.


· Onboarding: we’ll advise you on how to set up a Dutch bank account, apply for health insurance, getting a Dutch BSN number, writing in with a dentist and general practitioner and other useful or necessary cases to arrange.


· New Hire Dinner organized for all newly recruited engineers to make them aware of our Dutch tax system and explaining the Dutch payslip.


· A few social gatherings with all Xelvin employees and recruited engineers;


o New Years drink at the local PSV stadium, where you’ll get a tour of the building and beverages and bites are served.


o Summer BBQ at the Evoluon, where you can grow your social circle and dance to some nice music while enjoying the food.

Content Development:

  • Provide domain expertise for designing AI benchmarks and test scenarios.

Eligibility Criteria:

  • Master’s or PhD in Physics, Applied Physics, Engineering Physics, or a related discipline (PhD preferred).
  • Strong foundation in theoretical and applied physics .
  • Demonstrated expertise in one or more areas:
  • Computational modeling, simulations, or numerical methods.
  • Advanced topics (e.G., quantum field theory, condensed matter, astrophysics).

Preferred Skills:

  • Familiarity with AI/ML models, data annotation, and prompt engineering (bonus).

Why Join Innodata?

  • Collaborate with top-tier researchers and engineers globally.

title: Backend Developer 3d Cpq Integration And Automation
description:
Formify is looking for a Backend Developer who connects configurators, pricing logic and CAD automation straight to production. You build the systems that turn web clicks into CNC files. From browser to factory. No middle steps.


You must be located within four hours of Central European Time, either ahead or behind.


Company profile

Formify builds an end to end 3D CPQ platform for custom interiors. Customers configure kitchens and wardrobes in real time 3D. Manufacturers get instant production files.

What makes us different

  • We build everything ourselves. No engines. No templates
  • Our tech is fast, scalable and deeply parametric
  • From visualization to production, we close the loop
  • We work directly with decision makers and move fast


We outgrew our first version. Now we need you to build what comes next.


Role description

You own the backend architecture. You design APIs, link pricing with production logic, and extend CAD tools with code. You make decisions, set direction and write the code yourself.

Your work powers the factory. Quotes, orders, CNC files. Fully automated. You bring structure, depth and technical leadership.


Your work includes:

  • Building and scaling APIs for configurators, pricing and production
  • Extending Grasshopper and RhinoCommon with Python and C Sharp
  • Integrating CNC formats like DXF, STEP, G code and BTL
  • Automating the full flow from quote to machine
  • Talking to engineers, product and non technical stakeholders


Requirements:

  • 5 plus years of backend experience
  • Strong in Python and C#
  • Experience with REST APIs in production
  • Knowledge of CAD, parametric systems or CPQ workflows
  • Clear communication and ability to guide others


Bonus points for

  • Grasshopper and RhinoCommon expertise
  • Experience in furniture, interior or manufacturing tech
  • Affinity with mathematics and production processes


Conditions

  • Independent contract with strong potential for extension
  • Salary up to €210 daily rate
  • 25 paid holiday days
  • Fully remote team
  • Minimal overhead, no micromanagement
  • Competitive compensation at senior level
  • You must be located within two hours of CET


Ready to push code straight into machines

Send an email to or send Lars a message at +31 .


Formify is exclusively partnering with Haystack People for this role. They will support you throughout the process and handle the initial screening, focusing on both your relevant experience and the soft skills that match the company’s needs.

title: Content Rater
description:
Job Title: Content Rater

Location: Av. Maria Coelho Aguiar, 215 - Jardim São Luís, São Paulo - SP,

100% Onsite.

Work from office 9am-4pm BRT.

Salary: BRL 2100/month

Languages required: Portuguese and English

About the Role

Our project currently seeks a Content Rater. The main goal of this position is to identify and rate various types of content (mostly text, but it can also include audio, video and photos) as per the defined policies and guidelines. The responsibilities include reviewing and rating user/AI-generated content. Ratings should be made within the provided task guidelines and supported by written explanations to enhance rating quality.

Roles and Responsibilities

  • Evaluate and rate various content types, including mostly text, but also audio, video and photos.
  • Assess AI generated responses for accuracy, factuality, relevance, helpfulness, language usage, and alignment with user intent.
  • Conduct research & fact-checking by comparing AI-generated response with other generally available sources (ex: Web search, social media, 3rd party materials) and identify key differences and trends.
  • Conduct side-by-side comparisons and identify key differences between responses.
  • Rate and stack rank responses& provide clear reasoning while ensuring adherence to guidelines
  • Ensure consistency in rating decisions
  • Supporting internal training
  • Conducting QA/Peer reviews
  • Attend customer calls/calibration sessions/calls
  • Supporting other projects outside of your core project, as and when required,
  • Re-writing prompts or responses

Skills Requirements & Qualifications

  • English B1/B2
  • Native in Portuguese language to perform the content rating
  • University Degree (preferred)
  • 1 year of relevant experience (inclusive of journalism, literature, writing or other comparable experience)
  • Basic level computer handling skills (along with a typing speed of 25-30 words per minute)
  • Comfortable with G suite, especially Google Sheets
  • Excellent in verbal & writing skills with the ability to present reasoning in a clear, concise, and logical manner
  • Understanding of various AI models and their capabilities.
  • Knowledge of established guidelines and best practices for content rating.
  • Experience in evaluating and comparing content from different sources.
  • Detail oriented, rigorous, analytical skills to assess content factuality, relevance, and alignment with user intent.
  • Research skills to evaluate content accuracy and identify trustworthy sources.
  • Critical thinking skills to identify biases, inconsistencies, and limitations in AI-generated responses.
  • Attention to detail to review content for grammar, style, and adherence to ethical/legal standards.
